errors.text_span: Няма ясно изразени последователни промени във височината на стълбовете.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there are no consistent changes in the height of the bars, when they are clearly and intentionally sorted in descending order from left to right.

errors.text_span: Някои стълбове са визуално подчертани с различни нюанси на цвета и детайли, но без допълнителни бележки.
errors.evidence: This description of the visual highlight is inaccurate. Only one bar, corresponding to Bulgaria (BG), is highlighted. The method of highlighting is a rectangular box, not "different shades of color and details". The description also fails to identify which country is highlighted.
